title: Navy Pier Chicago: Private Sailboat Charter with Captain
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
On A Boat Sailing offers an all-inclusive, private VIP sailing experience departing from the brand-new Navy Pier Marina in Downtown Chicago. If you appreciate attention to detail, hospitality, and sophisticated service, this is the boat rental for you! Amenities on board include:

Pricing for private groups up to 7 guests.
Custom pricing available for larger groups up to 12.
Anchoring in the Chicago Playpen for swim and float parties.
Swim platform with rinse shower-lily pad, noodles, life-jackets and floaties.
Large open cockpit seating area.
Complimentary beverages and snacks or BYO (alcohol allowed).
Stereo surround sound speakers with Bluetooth connection.
Fridge with ice, fully stocked kitchenware.
Skyline views of Downtown Chicago, Navy Pier and the Chicago Lighthouse.
Anchoring for concerts at Northerly Island.
Kitchen, bathroom and changing room on board.
